title: Zotero Duplicate Paper Queue
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=research:paper library_name=* duplicate_flag=*
| stats sum(eval(if(duplicate_flag="yes",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by library_name
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending duplicate papers backlog by library for research library cleanup.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside research library cleanup.
implementation: Mark each `research:paper` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `library_name`.
visualization: Table of library with pending duplicate papers counts.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates where unfinished duplicate papers are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in research library cleanup.
